name: NeMo Guardrails & Presidio
metaTitle: AI Guardrails and PII Redaction: NeMo Guardrails and Presidio
description: Techlio adds input and output guardrails and automatic redaction of personal data to AI systems, so sensitive information stays protected and responses stay within policy.
h1: Guardrails and data redaction *for AI in production.*
answer: NeMo Guardrails is an open-source toolkit for controlling what an AI system will accept and say, and Presidio is an open-source tool for detecting and redacting personal data. Techlio uses them to screen inputs, constrain outputs and remove sensitive data before it reaches a model or a log.

builds.title: Input and output guardrails
builds.text: Rules that block prompt injection attempts, off-topic requests and responses outside policy.

builds.title: PII detection and redaction
builds.text: Personal data masked before prompts are sent to a model and before anything is logged.

builds.title: Testing
builds.text: Adversarial test suites that show the guardrails hold before release.

fits: Your AI system handles personal or regulated data

The assistant is exposed to the public or to customers

faqs.question: Do guardrails stop every attack?
faqs.answer: No single control does. We combine guardrails with limited tool permissions, human approval and monitoring.

faqs.question: Does redaction reduce answer quality?
faqs.answer: Sometimes slightly. We tune what is masked so the model keeps the context it needs.
